blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A loophole in the law apparently allowed a Vietnamese firm to fully operate a taxi fleet using electric vehicles (EVs) in the country despite the 1987 Constitution limiting foreign ownership, according to the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) and the Office of the Solicitor General (OSG). During the House of Representatives committee on transportation hearing on Wednesday, several lawmakers questioned why the foreign firm was allowed to operate locally, raising concerns whether the move remains in accordance with the Constitution.
